name: Post-reply nurture
when_to_use: Routed to automatically when a cold sequence gets an interested reply that is not yet a booked meeting. Never selected as a campaign's opening sequence.
rationale: An interested reply is the most commonly wasted asset in outbound: it is treated as a win and dropped. The meeting is not booked until it is booked. Ten value-led touches with wide gaps, each carrying something useful, is what converts interest into a calendar entry without re-pitching.
cites: skills/gtme-sequence/SKILL.md (nurture track doctrine, carried forward from run 1)

phases.intent: Nurture with insight and resources. Give before asking again.
Address the objection holding them back, and show a peer who moved past it.
Gentle urgency and results. Only real urgency - a verifiable date, never manufactured scarcity.
Final value, then a soft close that leaves the door open.

cadence.why: Wider gaps than cold. A warm contact who goes quiet is busy, not uninterested, and crowding them converts interest into avoidance.

constraints: never re-pitch the original offer verbatim
every touch carries something usable on its own
